name: write_practice_questions
title: Write practice questions from a document set
description: Have a model write question-and-answer pairs from each passage of a document set, mixing what/which, why/how and comparison questions, then filter them. Returns the file of pairs for review and training. Uses the GPU for minutes to an hour.

model.description: Local model id that writes the pairs; null uses the model recommended for this machine.

mix.description: Ask for a mix of question types.

questions.description: Path of the saved question set.
